name: Bastion
short_description: An isometric action RPG where the ground builds itself under your feet and a narrator reacts to everything.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: An isometric action RPG where the ground builds itself under your feet and a narrator reacts to everything.

identity.core_loop: Explore a level, fight, find a core, rebuild the Bastion, choose upgrades.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Tight combat; the narrator turns play into story.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: The narrator is meta-diegetic commentary; the world assembles as you walk; a small HUD for health and tonics.

rendering.signature: Hand-painted isometric tiles with the light painted in; the ground assembles as you walk.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: A fixed camera lets you paint lighting once and keep it.

identity.audio_mood: Iconic acoustic-trip-hop score and a gravelly narrator.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: A world that rises under the player's feet, and a voice that notices what they do.
